name: Sarah Jenkins
text: The Hyaluronic Hydration Serum completely transformed my skin texture. After years of struggling with dryness and flaky patches, my face feels incredibly plump, smooth, and glowing 24/7.

name: Dr. Evelyn Vance, MD
text: I recommend Aura Derma's Retinol Night Cream to my patients. The encapsulated formula releases retinol slowly overnight, which minimizes dryness and typical retinoid irritation while yielding superb anti-aging results.

name: Marcus K.
text: The Clarifying Clinical Peel facial at the clinic was a lifesaver. My persistent acne breakouts calmed down within 48 hours, and my post-acne dark marks have faded significantly.
